title: 第14章 居然有星际通讯能给地球打电话-《同时被N个S级哨兵盯上怎么办》
content:
第(1/3)页

    秦夙不太想说。

    等轮椅推过来，魏知弦对她伸出大手。

    她也没拒绝。

    被扶着坐上轮椅，腿上再盖上厚实又柔软的毛毯。

    推出医疗中心，随着电梯下行，沉默在狭小的空间中蔓延。

    秦夙突然感觉脚踝被什么东西碰了碰。

    转头低眸一看。

    “黑豹！”她先是吓了一跳。

    再看黑豹似乎没有攻击意图，又觉得离谱，“怎么会有只黑豹？是你的精神体吗？”

    “嗯。”魏知弦从她身后应了下，“你不是喜欢猫？它很温顺，可以撸。”

    那黑豹就真的，特别乖顺，从秦夙脚边嗅到了她膝盖，然后歪头就把大脑袋搁在了秦夙腿上。

    黑豹脑袋垫在秦夙腿上，还发出了一阵呼噜噜的声音。

    睁大的一双眼睛里，眼瞳是黑色中渐变出一些深蓝，跟魏知弦头发颜色一样！

    “你……别咬我啊，我身上可没几两肉，不够你吃的。”秦夙有点怯生生的，却又很好奇，把手放到黑豹脑袋上。

    油光水滑的毛，手感厚实，特别舒服！

    秦夙嘿嘿一笑，回头兴奋的说：“它真的好乖啊魏知弦！”

    魏知弦本来就低头看着她呢，张嘴，“我的话你……”

    说到一半，又紧急撤销，“是的。”

    “你刚才想说什么？”秦夙抬手指他，“是不是想怼我？”

    魏知弦小幅度摇头，“没有。”

    “就是有！”秦夙皱眉，“你是因为卢娜的话才放黑豹来哄我的，你现在是因为我兴致不高，才没拿话堵我！”

    魏知弦快速眨动几下眼睛，清了清嗓子，“想给爷爷打通电话吗？我可以安排。”

    啊？！还能给地球上的爷爷打电话吗？！

    秦夙眼睛瞪的老大！

    “魏知弦，你真是神通广大啊！我真的能联系我爷爷吗？”

    “昨天已经给你提交了星际通讯申请，光脑上刚收到通知，已经被白塔批准了。但你必须保证，这通电话不会被爷爷告知给地球上的其他人，要绝对保密。”

    “我我我我，我能保证！”秦夙立刻竖起三根手指指天发誓，“我爷爷是个老文化人，最重信守诺了！我跟他说说，他肯定不会说出去的！”

    “电话会全程被白塔安全中心监听。”魏知弦这时注视着秦夙双眼，“当你们聊到敏感话题，会有提示音介入，或强行切断通话。你介意吗？”

    秦夙思考了几秒，苦笑，“介意的话，这电话就没法打了吧。”

    黑豹嗓子里咕噜一声，又用脑袋蹭蹭秦夙，像是一种安慰。

    她转回头，对黑豹再度扬起喜悦的笑意。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Qin Su didn’t want to say it.

When the wheelchair came over, Wei Zhixian stretched out his big hand to her.

She didn’t refuse either.

He was helped into the wheelchair and his legs were covered with a thick and soft blanket.

​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​As the elevator goes down, silence spreads in the small space.

Qin Su suddenly felt something touching his ankle.

​​He turned his head and looked down.

"Black Panther!" She was startled at first.

Seeing that the black panther seemed to have no intention of attacking, I thought it was outrageous, "Why is there a black panther? Is it your spiritual body?"

"Yeah." Wei Zhixian responded from behind her, "Don't you like cats? They are very docile and can be petted."

The black panther was really, really obedient. He smelled Qin Su’s knees from her feet, then tilted his head and placed his big head on Qin Su’s legs.

The black panther’s head rested on Qin Su’s legs and he made a snoring sound.

In a pair of wide-open eyes, the pupils are black and gradually turn into some dark blue, which is the same color as Wei Zhixian's hair!

"You... don't bite me. I don't have a few ounces of meat on me, not enough for you to eat." Qin Su was a little timid, but curious, and put his hand on the black panther's head.

The hair is smooth and smooth, feels thick and very comfortable!

Qin Su chuckled, turned around and said excitedly: "It's really good, Wei Zhixian!"

Wei Zhixian was looking down at her and opened his mouth, "What do you want me to say..."

Halfway through, he urgently canceled it, "Yes."

"What did you want to say just now?" Qin Su pointed at him, "Do you want to quarrel with me?"

Wei Zhixian shook his head slightly, "No."

"Yes!" Qin Su frowned, "You let the Black Panther come to coax me because of Luna's words. Now you don't stop me because I'm not in a good mood!"

Wei Zhixian blinked his eyes quickly a few times and cleared his throat, "Want to call grandpa? I can arrange it."

Huh?!Can I still call my grandpa on Earth?!

Qin Su’s eyes widened, boss!

"Wei Zhixian, you are so powerful! Can I really contact my grandfather?"

"I submitted an application for interstellar communication to you yesterday, and I just received a notification on the optical brain that it has been approved by the White Tower. But you must ensure that this call will not be informed by grandpa to other people on the earth, and it must be kept absolutely confidential."

"I, I, I, I can guarantee it!" Qin Su immediately raised three fingers and pointed to the sky and swore, "My grandpa is an old man of culture, and the most important thing is to keep his promises! If I tell him, he will definitely not tell anyone!"

"The entire phone call will be monitored by the White Tower Security Center." Wei Zhixian looked into Qin Su's eyes at this time, "When you talk about sensitive topics, there will be a prompt tone to intervene, or the call will be forcibly cut off. Do you mind?"

Qin Su thought for a few seconds and smiled bitterly, "If you mind, I can't make this call."

Black Panther purred in his throat and rubbed his head against Qin Su again, as if to comfort him.

She turned back and smiled happily at Black Panther again.

title_en: Chapter 14 There is actually interstellar communication that can call the earth - "What to do if you are targeted by N S-class sentries at the same time"
